definitions.explanation: A razor powered by electricity, used for shaving facial hair or body hair without a blade directly touching the skin.

examples.japanese: ⟦{毎朝|まいあさ}→毎朝：00966_maiasa⟧{電気剃刀|でんきかみそり}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{髭|ひげ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{剃|そ}る→剃る：00384_soru⟧。
examples.english: I shave my beard with an electric razor every morning.

examples.japanese: ⟦{父|ちち}→父：00566_chichi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{誕生日|たんじょうび}→誕生日：02910_tanjoubi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{電気剃刀|でんきかみそり}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦プレゼント→プレゼント：01791_purezento⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I gave my father an electric razor for his birthday.

examples.japanese: {電気剃刀|でんきかみそり}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{肌|はだ}→肌：02243_hada⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{優|やさ}しい⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦{敏感肌|びんかんはだ}→敏感肌：19065_binkanhada⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{向|む}いている→向く：02304_muku⟧。
examples.english: Electric razors are gentle on the skin, so they are suitable even for people with sensitive skin.

notes:
{電気剃刀|でんきかみそり} is the full Japanese term, but the loanword シェーバー (from English "shaver") is more commonly used in everyday conversation and advertising. In product names, ⟦{電気|でんき}→電気：09780_denki⟧シェーバー and ⟦{電動|でんどう}→電動：06412_dendou⟧シェーバー are also common.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {電気剃刀|でんきかみそり}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{替刃|かえば} — replacement blade for an electric razor
- ⟦{防水|ぼうすい}→防水：06428_bousui⟧{電気剃刀|でんきかみそり} — waterproof electric razor
- {回転式|かいてんしき}{電気剃刀|でんきかみそり} — rotary electric razor

SIMILAR WORDS:
- シェーバー — shaver (loanword; more common in daily speech)
- {剃刀|かみそり} — razor (manual, non-electric)
- T⟦{字|じ}→字：01606_ji⟧カミソリ — safety razor; T-shaped razor
